title: Speaking Part 3 and Fluency
ringkas: Diskusi abstrak, memperpanjang jawaban, dan ungkapan pengisi waktu
goals: menjawab pertanyaan **Part 3** yang abstrak dengan opini, alasan, dan contoh
berbicara **lancar** dengan ungkapan pengisi yang natural
memperbaiki **kesalahan pelafalan dan tata bahasa** yang umum

lesson.text: **Part 3** adalah diskusi lebih mendalam dengan penguji, biasanya tentang masyarakat atau gagasan umum yang berkaitan dengan topik Part 2. Penguji menilai kemampuanmu **berpendapat, membandingkan, dan memprediksi**. Jawaban 3 sampai 5 kalimat biasanya cukup.

lesson.title: 1. Rumus jawaban Part 3
table: [[I think it depends on the person.]]
[[Because some people need more time to adapt.]]
[[For instance, older people often find technology harder.]]
[[So I'd say education plays a key role.]]

lesson.title: 2. Jenis pertanyaan Part 3
table: [[Do you think people read less today?]]
[[How is it different from the past?]]

lesson.title: 3. Ungkapan untuk berpendapat
table: [[It's hard to say, but I'd guess ...]]

lesson.title: 5. Pelafalan yang perlu diperhatikan
table: lidah di antara gigi, bukan t
v: gigi atas pada bibir bawah; w: bibir membulat
turun pada akhir pernyataan; naik pada pertanyaan ya/tidak

lesson.title: Memperpanjang jawaban
lesson.text: Gunakan tiga pertanyaan internal: *Why? For example? What about the future?* Menjawabnya akan menghasilkan jawaban yang lengkap tanpa harus menghafal.

lesson.title: Jangan mengulang pertanyaan persis
lesson.text: Mengulang pertanyaan berkali-kali terkesan membuang waktu. Cukup parafrase singkat atau langsung jawab.

practice.exp: Diskusi abstrak.

practice.q: Berapa kalimat biasanya cukup untuk jawaban Part 3?
practice.exp: 3-5 kalimat. Jawaban yang tepat: **3 sampai 5**.
Opini + alasan + contoh.

practice.q: Untuk membandingkan masa lalu dan sekarang, pakai...
practice.exp: Perbandingan.
Opini. Jawaban yang tepat: **In my view, ...**
Setuju sebagian.
Prediksi. Jawaban yang tepat: **I believe it will ... as ...**

practice.exp: Sebab. Jawaban yang tepat: **One reason is that ...**
Solusi. Jawaban yang tepat: **They could ... in order to ...**
Natural. Jawaban yang tepat: **Well, let me think...**
Memperbaiki diri.

practice.q: Susun kalimat: "Menurut saya, pendidikan sangat penting."
practice.answer: In my view, education is very important.
practice.exp: Urutan yang benar: In my view, education is very important.

practice.q: Susun kalimat: "Salah satu alasannya adalah kota menawarkan pekerjaan."
practice.answer: One reason is that cities offer jobs.
practice.exp: Urutan yang benar: One reason is that cities offer jobs.

practice.q: Susun kalimat: "Pemerintah dapat membangun lebih banyak taman."
practice.exp: Urutan yang benar: Governments could build more parks.

practice.q: Do you think people read less nowadays?
turns: Do you think people read less nowadays?
answers: I think people read less because they spend more time on their phones.
In my view, they read less because they are busy.
I believe people read less because videos are more popular.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I think people read less because they spend more time on their phones.  atau  In my view, they read less because they are busy.  atau  I believe people read less because videos are more popular.

practice.q: How is education different from the past?
turns: How is education different from the past?
answers: In the past, students used books, whereas nowadays they use tablets.
Nowadays, students learn online, but in the past they went to class.
It is different because technology plays a bigger role.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: In the past, students used books, whereas nowadays they use tablets.  atau  Nowadays, students learn online, but in the past they went to class.  atau  It is different because technology plays a bigger role.

practice.q: Why do many people move to big cities?
turns: Why do many people move to big cities?
answers: One reason is that cities offer more jobs.
One reason is that big cities have better schools.
They move because there are more opportunities.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: One reason is that cities offer more jobs.  atau  One reason is that big cities have better schools.  atau  They move because there are more opportunities.

practice.q: Will people travel more in the future?
turns: Will people travel more in the future?
answers: I believe people will travel more because transport will be cheaper.
I think they will travel more as the world becomes more connected.
Yes, I think so because flights are becoming cheaper.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I believe people will travel more because transport will be cheaper.  atau  I think they will travel more as the world becomes more connected.  atau  Yes, I think so because flights are becoming cheaper.

practice.q: What can governments do to reduce traffic?
turns: What can governments do to reduce traffic?
answers: They could build more public transport in order to reduce traffic.
Governments could encourage people to use buses.
They could make the roads wider and add more train lines.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: They could build more public transport in order to reduce traffic.  atau  Governments could encourage people to use buses.  atau  They could make the roads wider and add more train lines.

practice.q: Some people say money brings happiness. Do you agree?
turns: Some people say money brings happiness. Do you agree?
answers: That's partly true, but money is not everything.
I partly agree, but relationships are also important.
In my view, money helps, but it is not the only factor.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: That's partly true, but money is not everything.  atau  I partly agree, but relationships are also important.  atau  In my view, money helps, but it is not the only factor.

quiz.q: How do young people spend their free time?
turns: How do young people spend their free time?
answers: Generally speaking, they spend a lot of time online.
In many cases, they meet friends or play sports.

quiz.q: What will cities look like in fifty years?
turns: What will cities look like in fifty years?
answers: It's hard to say, but I'd guess there will be more green spaces.
I'm not sure, but I think cities will be more crowded.
It's hard to say, but I think they will use more clean energy.
